objects.name: Analytic 1932
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a process loading a packet capture driver or executing a known capture utility on an Industrial Control System (ICS) host's network interface, from a process or account not associated with documented network analysis responsibilities. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.
